question: Find all restaurants that are on residential streets.
sql:
WITH buffered_roads AS (
  SELECT r.id, ST_Buffer(ST_Transform(r.geometry, 'EPSG:4326', 'EPSG:32629', always_xy := true), 50) AS geom
  FROM lisbon_roads r
  WHERE r.class = 'residential'
)
SELECT DISTINCT p.names.primary AS name, p.basic_category AS category, p.addresses[1].locality AS locality
FROM lisbon_places p
JOIN buffered_roads br ON ST_Within(ST_Transform(p.geometry, 'EPSG:4326', 'EPSG:32629', always_xy := true), br.geom)
WHERE p.basic_category = 'restaurant';

question: Which roads pass by the Belém Tower?
sql:
WITH tower AS (
  SELECT ST_Buffer(ST_Transform(geometry, 'EPSG:4326', 'EPSG:32629', always_xy := true), 50) AS geom
  FROM lisbon_places
  WHERE names.primary = '벨렘탑'
)
SELECT r.names.primary AS road_name, r.class AS road_class
FROM lisbon_roads r
JOIN tower t ON ST_Intersects(ST_Transform(r.geometry, 'EPSG:4326', 'EPSG:32629', always_xy := true), t.geom);

question: Find all clothing stores within 100 meters of the promenade called 'Passeio Marítimo de Algés'.
sql:
SELECT p.names.primary AS name, p.basic_category AS category
FROM lisbon_places p, lisbon_roads r
WHERE r.names.primary = 'Passeio Marítimo de Algés'
  AND p.basic_category = 'fashion_and_apparel_store'
  AND ST_DWithin(ST_Transform(p.geometry, 'EPSG:4326', 'EPSG:32629', always_xy := true), ST_Transform(r.geometry, 'EPSG:4326', 'EPSG:32629', always_xy := true), 100);

question: Which roads connect to Passeio Marítimo de Algés?
sql:
SELECT r2.names.primary AS connecting_road, r2.class AS road_class
FROM lisbon_roads r1, lisbon_roads r2
WHERE r1.names.primary = 'Passeio Marítimo de Algés'
  AND r1.id != r2.id
  AND ST_Touches(r1.geometry, r2.geometry);

question: List all restaurants in the Belém district.
sql:
SELECT p.names.primary AS name, p.basic_category AS category, p.addresses[1].locality AS locality
FROM lisbon_places p
WHERE p.basic_category = 'restaurant'
  AND ST_Within(p.geometry, ST_GeomFromText('POLYGON((-9.215 38.690, -9.195 38.690, -9.195 38.705, -9.215 38.705, -9.215 38.690))', 'EPSG:4326'));

question: Find all footpaths that are entirely inside the Parque das Nações area.
sql:
SELECT r.names.primary AS name, r.class AS road_class
FROM lisbon_roads r
WHERE r.class = 'footway'
  AND ST_Contains(ST_GeomFromText('POLYGON((-9.11 38.75, -9.09 38.75, -9.09 38.77, -9.11 38.77, -9.11 38.75))', 'EPSG:4326'), r.geometry);
